provider: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
product_name: Flood and Windstorm exposure data - catastrophe data hub.xlsx
version_or_release: 2023-12-05 public resource; underlying exposure as of year-end 2020
retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of the EIOPA Catastrophe Data Hub exposure workbook listed on 2023-12-05. No XLSX bytes were acquired. Raw/derived redistribution remains unreviewed pending inspection of the exact workbook and any file-specific or third-party notices.
intended_use: Public aggregated European insured-exposure benchmark for flood and windstorm, useful for distinguishing insured exposure from physical building stock and confidential policy portfolios. The sample is not a 100% market view and must not be grossed up or reinterpreted without an explicit methodology.

licensing.terms_version_or_date: EIOPA legal notice reviewed 2026-08-10; public resource dated 2023-12-05
licensing.attribution_requirements: Acknowledge EIOPA as the source as required by the EIOPA legal notice. Follow its conditions for transformed/republished material and EIOPA material incorporated into sold documents.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: No share-alike requirement is recorded in the general EIOPA website notice. Third-party material is excluded and must be reviewed separately.
licensing.notes: Because the workbook is based on insurer submissions and has not been inspected for file-specific notices, only metadata-level reuse is cleared by this review. This is an engineering rights assessment, not legal advice.

redistribution.conditions: Only repository-authored metadata about the public EIOPA resource is cleared here. Raw or derived workbook redistribution remains blocked until exact-file and third-party rights are explicitly reviewed.

privacy.notes: This admission describes only EIOPA's aggregated public release. The technical description states that data were aggregated to NUTS2 to ensure anonymity; undertaking-level submissions remain outside scope.

spatial.extent: EEA countries represented at country and NUTS2 level in the public analysis; exact workbook geography must be preserved

temporal.extent: Insured exposure as of year-end 2020; public workbook resource dated 2023-12-05

variables_and_units.name: sum insured
variables_and_units.description: Aggregated monetary replacement value of insured residential/commercial buildings as defined by EIOPA, net of reinsurance business and coinsurance. Exact currency/value-unit conventions require workbook review.

review.notes: Metadata-only approval. Raw/derived XLSX publication remains blocked pending exact-file rights, byte identity and schema/unit review.
